claims.assertion: Cyndriel is a desert at 0.7g with about 80% oxygen; Earth arrivals need acclimation.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Aldebaran’s nebula filters its intense radiation; near-perpetual daylight supports adapted red-orange flora.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Some cactus-like plants float on unexplained antigravity cores and spread spores through lakes.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Native Amélie are 6D-plus energy beings who communicate telepathically and appear in observer-suited forms.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Taygeta’s long-standing Cyndriel colony serves as an Alcyone Council wayport, shared mainly with Engans and Solatians.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Taygetans grow imported crops underground under controlled conditions to avoid disrupting Cyndriel’s native ecosystem.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

review_flags: Cyndriel’s surface–orbit time discrepancy is unexplained.
